$description: Design tokens for www.boona.in, the personal site of Boopathi Thangamani (Boona), AI Solutions Architect, TN, India. Written in the W3C Design Tokens format ($value and $type), which Tokens Studio for Figma, Style Dictionary and most token tools read. This file is the single source of truth: design/scripts/build-tokens.mjs writes css/tokens.css (which the page loads), the Figma variables and the contrast report from it. Never edit a value in css/site.css or Figma by hand; change it here and rebuild. Lengths are px strings. Text sizes that scale with the screen carry their CSS clamp() under $extensions['in.boona'].fluid; $value is the size on a 1440 px desktop and 'phone' is the size on a 390 px phone.

ink.$description: Text, the rule under each section title, the top bar, the main button, the hover fill on writing rows.

quiet.$description: Secondary text: small labels, section notes, case-study paragraphs.

line.$description: Hairlines: borders, table rules, the grid overlay.

on-bar.$description: Text and icons on the top bar.

teal.$description: Automation teal, the brand accent. Underlined key phrases, the status dot, the quote mark, the open quarter, the current timeline dot, the signals in the landing field. Also Thali's product colour. Never for letters: text in teal uses color.teal-ink.

lost.$description: Red for ending or negative states in the product screens (end-call button, live dot) and the dashed outline on unfilled placeholders.

signal.$description: Signal blue. Motion and tool overlays only: the grid draw, dashed landing outlines, selection boxes, the crosshair, focus rings. Never a static accent.

band.$description: The black band behind Boona Fit and the dark product screens.

surface.$description: Dark mini surfaces and the phone frame.

backdrop.$description: The dark screen backdrop behind the Boona Fit screen.

stage.$description: The lit centre of the Azhagi video stage (radial gradient start).

stage-deep.$description: The edge of the Azhagi video stage (radial gradient end).

bubble.$description: Incoming chat bubble in the Azhagi screen.

lane.$description: Timeline lanes in the Cue screen.

lane-empty.$description: Empty lanes in the Cue screen.

on-dark.$description: White at the five opacities used on the dark band and dark screens, from strongest to faintest. Since 2026-11-09 these five are the only white alphas in css/site.css.

shade.$description: Black at 35 %, the dim behind the landing name.

line.$description: Black at 18 %: the grid toggle's border.

product.$description: One colour per product. Boona Fit has none of its own: it sits on the dark band in white with the other three on its rings.

ground-glass.$description: White at 86 %: the top bar over the page, blurred.

ink-muted.$description: Black at 65 %: secondary text on a teal fill (open quarter label, teal plan bar caption).

teal-tint.$description: Teal at 14 %: the fill of a selected chip in the Thali screen.

teal-pulse.$description: Teal at 55 %: the start of the status dot's pulse ring.

violet-glow.$description: Violet at 35 %: the focus glow on the Cue prompt.

teal-ink.$description: Teal for letters only (5.0:1 on white): the Approach index numerals and Rule marks, 'Current' on the timeline, the quantities in the Thali screen. Dots, underlines, fills and borders stay color.teal.

mono.$description: Small uppercase labels, numbers in the top bar, the clock, the crosshair label, the FILL tags.

bold.$description: Loaded for Geist only; Geist Mono stops at 600.

tracking.$description: Letter-spacing. Negative for display sizes, positive for small uppercase labels.

name.$description: The landing name and result numbers.

heading.$description: Headings, the lede, the big quote, the email.

text.$description: Body-size text with a little pull-in: the intro, pills, buttons.

leading.$description: Line-height as a multiple of the size.

typography.$description: Complete text styles as used on the page. fontSize is the desktop value; see $extensions for the fluid rule and the phone size.

name.$description: The landing name, 'Boopathi Thangamani'. Grows to 200 px on very wide screens.

section-title.$description: The large title at the head of each section ('Four products, all in beta.').

section-title-mid.$description: The smaller section title used where the words are longer.

big-number.$description: The years number pinned beside the timeline. Tabular figures.

big-number-unit.$description: The word 'years' beside the big number, in the quiet colour.

lede.$description: The opening sentence of the Approach section.

quote.$description: The big testimonial, with a teal opening quote mark hanging in the margin.

h2.$description: Case-study headlines and other second-level headings.

h3.$description: Third-level headings, such as the approach rows.

table-title.$description: Post titles in the Writing table.

result-number.$description: Result figures under each case study ('1.7 s'). Tabular figures; the unit is 45 % of the size, medium weight, quiet colour.

body.$description: The default: paragraphs, lists, form fields.

intro.$description: The landing intro paragraph, 38 characters wide at most.

label.$description: The small uppercase mono label (the .m class): section numbers, fact labels, meta bars, the footer. Quiet colour; bold parts switch to ink at 600.

pill.$description: The 'Open to projects' pill in the top bar: 30 px tall, ink background, white text, pulsing teal dot.

button.$description: The main button ('Send the brief'): ink background, white text, 16 px by 22 px padding, square corners.

grid.$description: A 12-column grid in a 1280 px container. Columns sit 24 px apart; the page edge keeps a 24 px gutter.

max-width.$description: The container. Centred, with the gutter on each side when the window is narrower.

desktop.$description: Between columns, made of a 12 px inset on each side.

sticky-top.$description: Where a pinned column rests: the top bar plus 32 px.

phone-max.$description: Phone layout up to here: 4 columns, 16 px gutter, no pinned columns, the landing field off.

tablet-max.$description: Tablet layout from 640 px to here: 8 columns, no pinned columns.

desktop-min.$description: Desktop from here: 12 columns, pinned columns, the gliding scroll with a mouse.

space.$description: The spacing steps the page uses, in px, plus the vertical rhythm of a section.

title-to-content.$description: From the rule under the title to the first content row.

label-to-title.$description: From the small label to the big title.

title-to-rule.$description: From the title's baseline area to the 1 px ink rule.

radius.$description: Corners are mostly square. Rounded where something is a chip, a tag or a dot.

hairline.$description: Tiny chips and the ends of bars.

label.$description: The crosshair label and other small tags.

hairline.$description: Table rules, box borders, dotted-field edges.

rule.$description: The line under each section title.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring, 3 px outside the element.

placeholder.$description: Around unfilled placeholder text while data-placeholders is 'show'.

snap.$description: A product screen snapping into place.

reveal.$description: Content fading in as it enters the viewport; the grid drawing itself.

glide.$description: A menu link easing the page to its section.

field.$description: The landing field fading in after load, with a 200 ms delay.

snap.$description: Fast out, soft landing. Screens snapping, bars, chips.

ease.$description: A gentle expo-style out. Reveals, transforms.

scroll.$description: Ease-in-out cubic, used by the script for menu-link scrolling.

glide-time-constant.$description: With a mouse wheel the page eases toward its target with an exponential lerp of this time constant. Off for touch, keyboard and reduced motion.

reveal-offset.$description: How far revealed content rises as it fades in.

reduced-motion.$description: With 'reduce motion' on: no gliding, no grid draw, no snapping, no landing field; screens shown finished.

shadow.$description: The only shadows on the site: under the depicted devices, so they read as objects on the sheet.

cursor.$description: Drop shadow on the demo cursor.
